body.title: Add opt-in source-inspecting execution and divided prompts
body.summary: Extend ModelDimensionSpec with source-inspection opt-in; use existing reviewer-session execution with code-review timeout/silence limits. Update shared chunk and gather builders for opt-in-aware source inspection in chunk, obligation, relation and reduction calls, preserving citations/uncertainty and other dimensions.
acceptanceChecks: Opted-in single/chunk/gather/relation/reduction calls select reviewer-session mode, repo cwd and existing deadlines; no summary-only or closed-evidence instruction remains on those calls.
Shared prompts allow read-only Read/Grep/Glob and Codex commands, prohibit writes/test execution, preserve source citations and uncertainty; absent opt-in retains current behavior.
Regression tests cover execution roles, retry/deadline propagation and missing-session failure without fabricated pass.

tests.name: Source-inspection opt-in reaches single, chunk, obligation, relation and reduction calls with bounded read-only sessions; unchanged dimensions retain structured mode.
Shared prompts preserve source citations and uncertainty; no summary-only/closed-evidence assumptions for opted-in calls.
